B is structurally different: built-in simple Hair BSDF reflection/transmission closures with an explicit source-UV V-axis and exact original colour/coverage. Its reduced plastic highlight is not adopted: darkness hides the defect.

All displayed head/body/hair world coordinates, triangles and source hair UV independently match original r126 exactly. Original diffuse and alpha subgraph nodes/images and all other material graphs remain exact; underlying skin pigment/exposure was not changed. Hair scattering changes scene radiance/framing, not anatomy or source albedo.

Both full .blend files independently reopen and recover the actual active material and complete current/hidden geometry. A does not retain its now-unreferenced original Hair datablock on reload; full original r126 remains exact rollback. B explicitly preserves that old material with a fake user. Neither material switch is a new complete character operation, root binding, natural dynamics or contact/runtime qualification.
